tips.title: 64 small prompts on a premium model
tips.detail: 64 short prompts ($11.82) ran on claude-opus-5-5. Quick questions often work just as well on a faster, cheaper model or at lower effort.

tips.title: The cache expired 23 times during a pause
tips.detail: The prompt cache lives 5 minutes. After a longer pause the next call writes the whole context again, which cost about $3.17 here. Finish a step before a break, or compact a long session before stepping away.

tips.title: Very long session: 412 calls ($9.64)
tips.detail: "Refactor the record parser" ran for 412 model calls. Context grows with every turn — split long efforts into focused sessions.

tips.title: 2 prompts with 150+ tool calls
tips.detail: The busiest prompt triggered 187 tool calls. Long tool loops often mean a missing instruction or a flaky test — consider breaking the task up.
